site.metaTitle: tezda: an assistant that answers your customers
site.metaDescription: tezda answers your customers in Telegram and Instagram in their language, takes every one into a CRM funnel, hands over to a person and reminds you about tasks. Try it free for 3 days.
site.hero.title: Your customers get an answer in seconds, you get every lead
site.hero.subtitle: tezda answers customers in Telegram and Instagram in their own language, takes every one into a funnel in your CRM, hands the chat to a person when needed and reminds you about follow-up tasks.
site.features.title: What tezda does
site.feature1.title: Answers in the customer’s language
site.feature1.body: Telegram and Instagram messages get an answer in Uzbek, Russian or English, in the customer’s own script.
site.feature2.title: Every customer becomes a lead
site.feature2.body: Each conversation lands in a funnel with a score, so nobody is forgotten.
site.feature3.title: Hands over to a person
site.feature3.body: When a customer needs a human, your team gets the chat and takes over.
site.feature4.title: Reminds you about tasks
site.feature4.body: Follow-ups and call-backs are reminded in time, so deals do not go cold.
site.steps.title: How to start
site.step1.title: Sign up
site.step1.body: Enter your business name and e-mail, then confirm with your phone number in Telegram.
site.step2.title: Connect your bot
site.step2.body: Create a Telegram bot in a minute and paste its token. We guide you step by step.
site.step3.title: Add your knowledge
site.step3.body: Upload a price list or type common answers, try the assistant in the test chat and turn it on.

site.plans.subtitle: Pick a plan after the free days; you can change it later.

site.enterprise.name: All included
site.enterprise.body: For larger companies: your own limits, setup help and a personal contact.
site.faq.title: Questions and answers
site.faq1.a: A lead is a customer who wrote to you and showed interest. Plans count new leads per month; a returning customer is not counted again.
site.faq2.a: Telegram and Instagram direct messages. More messengers will follow.
site.faq3.a: Each company’s data is kept apart from all others, access is by sign-in only, and you can ask for deletion at any time.
site.faq4.a: Until you pay, the assistant stops answering. Messages are still kept and your team still sees them and can answer by hand.
site.faq5.q: Do I need a card to try it?
site.faq5.a: No. The 3 free days start without a card.
site.faq6.a: Yes. You pay each period yourself; nothing is charged automatically, so you cancel by simply not paying.

amocrm.desc: Creates a lead in your amoCRM for every new lead from the chats.

botModeDesc.OFF: The assistant does not reply. The system still sends each customer's own message back to them (echo test), so do not use Off on a real customer account.

botModeDesc.LIVE: The assistant answers customers and hands over to an operator in the Web Inbox when needed. A Telegram group is optional.

igConnect.title: Connect Instagram
igConnect.step1: In the Meta App Dashboard, open Instagram > API setup with Instagram business login.
igConnect.step2: Click Generate token next to your Instagram professional account and copy it.
igConnect.step3: Paste it below. It is saved encrypted and is never shown again.
igConnect.doneNext: The account is off until you enable it. Enabling subscribes it to direct messages at Meta.
channels.dropPending: Skip messages sent while the bot was off
channels.dropPendingHint: Telegram keeps messages that arrived while no webhook was set. If they are skipped, the assistant does not answer old messages all at once. On by default for the first enable.
channels.fromServer: This bot is configured on the server, so it is managed there.
channels.needSecrets: Connecting from here needs the server's secure storage switched on. The technical administrator must switch it on in the server settings and restart the API.
channels.needUrl: Enabling needs the public https address of this server. The technical administrator must set it in the server settings and restart the API.
instagram.step1: Switch the Instagram account to a Professional account (Business or Creator).
instagram.step2: Create an app in Meta for Developers and add the Instagram API with Instagram Login.
instagram.step3: Request the permissions instagram_business_basic and instagram_business_manage_messages. Serving accounts you do not own needs Advanced Access (Meta app review).
instagram.step4: Sign in with the Instagram account to get an access token, and subscribe the app's webhook to the messages field.
instagram.step5: You can only answer a person after they write first: within 24 hours, up to 7 days for a human operator's reply. Text is limited to 1000 bytes.
connect.title: Connect Telegram
connect.s1.title: Open BotFather
connect.s1.hint: BotFather is Telegram's own bot for making bots. Look for the blue check next to its name.
connect.s2.title: Create your bot
connect.s2.hint: Send /newbot. It asks for a name (customers see it), then a username that ends in “bot”.
connect.s3.title: Copy the token
connect.s3.hint: BotFather replies with a token: numbers, a colon, then letters and digits. Copy all of it.
connect.s3.have: Already have a bot? Send /token to BotFather and choose it.
connect.s4.title: Paste it below
connect.s4.hint: It is saved encrypted and is never shown again.
connect.tokenHint: This does not look like a bot token. It is numbers, a colon, then letters and digits.
connect.doneNext: The account is off until you enable it. Enabling registers the webhook with Telegram.
